out_of_program_signers.explanation: Not a call site the census can count: the HoneypotChecker deployment is signed by Hardhat Ignition in a child process, with the DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY account that hardhat.config.ts builds; no ethers signing call exists in this file (manual read at 23a64617dca167976adc4645fed0e2c69e384820). The script refuses to run when DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY equals PRIVATE_KEY (:75), so the deploy is meant to use a different wallet and never the bot nonce; that comparison is raw-string (a 0x-prefix or case difference passes it) and the child inherits the bot key, which AUD-CONTRACTS-004 and AUD-CONTRACTS-001 record. Cross-linked from AUD-CENSUS-001, not duplicated.

reconciliation_note: Both lists are empty: every hand-confirmed transaction-signing site is in the census and every census-counted site is in this inventory (signing-census.ts --manual fails on any mismatch). The grep floor holds exactly the 23 counted sites; the census additionally reads two calls the grep patterns cannot match (getPair, allowance), both reads, listed here as auditor exclusions with evidence. The census-excluded reads (view fragments, staticCall) need no manual entry.
